card.name: Drug label preparation and interaction text
card.fires_on: Scattered positions in prescribing-information text, such as instructions to open, reconstitute or flush, interaction statements, and partway through brand or drug names. No single word type fits all cases.

modes.label: Preparation steps
modes.description: Verbs or word parts in handling instructions such as opening, reconstituting or flushing.

modes.label: Interaction statements
modes.description: Small words or letter pieces in drug-interaction sentences about CYP enzymes and exposure.

modes.label: Inside names
modes.description: Partway through brand or drug names and enzyme names.
modes.example: 7.2 Effect of SCE<<MB>>LIX on Other Drugs
